# apim_authz_policy (Resource)

A GAPL policy, deployed on every apply to the PDP gateways its `targets` name. Deleting a policy withdraws it from those gateways and keeps the entities it names. Requires APIM 4.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_authz_policy" "github_create_issue" {
  hrid        = "engineering-create-issue"
  entity_id   = "policy.engineering.create-issue"
  name        = "Engineering creates GitHub issues"
  policy_type = "MCP"
  policy_text = <<-EOT
    permit(
      principal in Group::"engineering",
      action == Action::"github.create_issue",
      resource == MCPTool::"github.create_issue"
    );
  EOT
  # An MCP proxy asks the default engine only.
  targets = ["default"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_id` (String) Id of the policy in the engine and in the Console: `policy.` then one or more segments separated
by `.`. Held by one policy of the environment, and fixed at creation.
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the policy; converges on re-apply
- `policy_text` (String) The GAPL text, one or more `permit` and `forbid` statements, replaced whole on every apply. A
template, with `?principal` or `?resource` in its scope, is refused.
- `policy_type` (String) What the policy governs, as the Console groups policies. Fixed at creation. must be one of ["MCP", "AGENT", "MODEL", "API", "CUSTOM"]

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID
- `targets` (List of String) The PDP gateways the policy is deployed to, each as the gateway reports its routing scope, or
`default`, or `*` for every gateway. An empty list falls back to the default engine on every
gateway. An MCP proxy asks the default engine only.
Default: []

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID
- `policy_status` (String) `DEPLOYED` after every apply. `DISABLED` once the policy is disabled in the Console, until the next
apply deploys it again.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_authz_policy.github_create_issue
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "engineering-create-issue"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_authz_policy.github_create_issue '{"environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "engineering-create-issue", "organization_id": "DEFAULT"}'
```
